queries.result: Chongqing’s official bureau states that registered-property and cadastral-map records can be queried online through YukuaiBan or service halls under defined access conditions. The Wanzhou government portal links the general government service platform; no point-based public parcel geometry service for Wanzhou was exposed. No address, title, rights-holder, or owner query was made.
